join_partner_meta_description: Own a clinic, a dog groomer's or a pet shop? Refer your customers and earn a commission on every purchase they make.
join_partner_hero_title_a: Own a clinic, a groomer's or a pet shop?
join_partner_hero_line: Refer your customers to Zurvann. {percent} of every purchase they make is yours.
join_partner_hero_bubble: Does a dog like me come to you? Send him to {name}.
join_partner_ways_title: Three ways to refer a customer
join_partner_way_link_detail: Every customer who comes through your link is credited to you.
join_partner_way_qr_title: A QR code for your counter
join_partner_way_qr_detail: The same link as a QR code, for your shop.
join_partner_way_number_detail: Enter a customer's number in your dashboard before they sign up. If they sign up with that number, they're yours.
join_partner_ways_note: If several partners enter the same number, the first one keeps it.
join_partner_ways_bubble: I started out from a counter just like this!
join_partner_step_call_detail: Tell us your business's name, what kind it is (clinic, groomer, pet shop) and the mobile number you'll sign in with.
join_partner_step_account_detail: Only {name} creates partner accounts, using that same mobile number.
join_partner_step_in_detail: You see your link, QR code and customers, and enter your IBAN (Sheba number) for the commission.
join_partner_commission_rule_total: Every purchase your customers make earns a commission: a share of the total of the courses they buy that time.
join_partner_commission_rule_paid: {name} pays the commission outside the site, by bank transfer to your IBAN, and marks it “Paid” on the site. You can see whether each commission is paid or unpaid.
join_partner_commission_rule_cancel: If the training is canceled afterward, the commission stays with you.
join_partner_ask_line: Have your business's name and your mobile number ready.
join_partner_error_line: Something went wrong. Try again, or call the center right now.
join_partner_commission_rule_steps: The more paying customers you bring, the higher your share. Your customers are counted from the start of the partnership and never reset.
